content: {"episode_id":"ep-05041","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-197 denial of CPT 93229 for medical necessity, acknowledging that prior authorization was missing. The clinical indication note documents recurrent palpitations and lightheadedness persisting despite initial evaluation, with a known history of nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency. The note states that continuous ambulatory monitoring is indicated to correlate these symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmic activity."}
